claim: arch_mapping_store.md's 'File Location' section contradicts itself within one paragraph: it opens with 'The journal lives beside the snapshot at the location the lifecycle pre-flight (ProjectResolver) answers: inside the .spex/ state directory ... The store takes the resolved path as input and computes no location of its own,' then closes with 'The retired --map/--map-file flags are gone with the file they pointed at; the journal's location is a function of --spec-dir alone.' The closing sentence is the pre-ProjectResolver model's leftover — a location computed from --spec-dir is exactly what the opening sentence, and this PR's NewMappingStore(path) signature, retire. test_mapping_store.md's Setup carries the matching leftover: line 12 says 'Construct a MappingStore instance pointing at the temp directory' while the sibling bullet on line 6 was already updated to 'at the fixture's resolved location.'
authoritative_source: arch_root_command.md's Global Flags section: '--spec-dir locates the authored spec tree and nothing else: the derived state — the snapshot and the task journal — resolves through the lifecycle module's pre-flight to the .spex/ state directory, the only layout there is.' This matches arch_mapping_store.md's own opening File Location sentence and the shipped NewMappingStore(path) constructor, which takes a caller-resolved path and computes nothing from --spec-dir itself.
evidence: The two sentences in arch_mapping_store.md's File Location paragraph assert opposite resolution models for the same store in the same paragraph, and only one of them (the opening) matches arch_root_command.md:45 and the code this PR ships. Until ProjectResolver (spexmachina-uiei.8) lands, every call site keeps the interim placeholder filepath.Join(specDir, ".history.jsonl") behind a TODO(bead:spexmachina-uiei.8) marker — deferred work already flagged, not a defect in this bead's own contract — so the stale sentences do not gate this bead's scope, only mislead whoever reads the leaf next.
proposed_fix: Reword arch_mapping_store.md's closing File Location sentence to state that --spec-dir no longer determines the journal's location at all (replace '...gone with the file they pointed at; the journal's location is a function of --spec-dir alone' with wording pointing at the lifecycle pre-flight's .spex/ resolution instead). Update test_mapping_store.md line 12 ('Construct a MappingStore instance pointing at the temp directory') to match the already-updated sibling bullet's 'at the fixture's resolved location.'
